items.title: Cyber Tunnel
items.description: Neon cyan rings in perspective around a magenta core. Bass warps the tunnel, mids lift the glow.

items.title: Iridescent Orb
items.description: A floating pearlescent sphere with a rim and a gloss. Bass pulses it, mids make it wobble.

items.title: Hyperspace Tunnel
items.description: Radial stars and light streaks. The warp speeds up on the beat.

items.title: Liquid Glass
items.description: A frosted glass panel with chromatic dispersion. Sound pulses the refraction.

items.title: Hex Lattice
items.description: An isometric honeycomb grid, warm at the centre. Ripples run out across the hexagons.

items.title: Phyllotaxis Bloom
items.description: Seeds on a golden-angle spiral. Sound pushes the orbits outward.

items.title: Metaball Lens
items.description: Three liquid blobs with a specular rim. Their radii breathe with the sound.

items.title: Ordered Dither
items.description: A 4x4 Bayer halftone in one colour. Sound ripples the threshold.

items.title: Pixel Plate
items.description: Stepped mosaic tiles. Sound steps the tile colours.

items.title: Harmonic Warp
items.description: Interfering sine ripples that displace one another with the harmonics.

items.title: Hyper Torus
items.description: A wireframe slice of a rotating 4D torus. Ring frequency follows the sound.
